title: AI History in 30 Seconds: 5 Moments That Mattered
description:

Inspired by @kloss_xyz's "key moments in the history of AI" prompt (yihui-dev/awesome-opus5-5-videos). Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
